reference: By the time they copied her, she had found her own look.
sk: Kým ju začali kopírovať, ona si už našla vlastný štýl.
cz: Než ji začaly kopírovat, už si našla vlastní styl.
acceptable: By the time they {copied|started copying|started to copy|began copying|began to copy} her, she had {already |}found her own {look|style}.
She had {already |}found her own {look|style} by the time they {copied|started copying|started to copy|began copying|began to copy} her.

mistakes.text: By the time they {copied|started copying} her, she {found|already found} her own {look|style}.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri „by the time“ bol dej hlavnej vety hotový skôr, preto Past Perfect: „had found“, nie „found“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U „by the time“ byl děj hlavní věty hotový dřív, proto Past Perfect: „had found“, ne „found“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With “by the time”, the main action was finished earlier, so use Past Perfect: “had found”, not “found”.

mistakes.text: By the time they {copied|started copying} her, she has {already |}found her own {look|style}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Príbeh je v minulosti, preto Past Perfect „had found“, nie Present Perfect „has found“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Příběh je v minulosti, proto Past Perfect „had found“, ne Present Perfect „has found“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The story is in the past, so use Past Perfect “had found”, not Present Perfect “has found”.

mistakes.text: By the time they had {copied|started copying} her, she found her own {look|style}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Perfect patrí k skoršiemu deju v hlavnej vete: „had found“; po „by the time“ zostáva Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Perfect patří k dřívějšímu ději v hlavní větě: „had found“; po „by the time“ zůstává Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Perfect goes with the earlier action in the main clause: “had found”; after “by the time” keep Past Simple.

mistakes.text: Until they {copied|started copying} her, she had found her own {look|style}.
mistakes.kind: until instead of by the time
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Kým“ tu znamená „by the time“ (do tej chvíle), nie „until“ (až kým).
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Než“ tu znamená „by the time“ (do té chvíle), ne „until“ (dokud).
mistakes.feedback_en: Here the meaning is “by the time” (at or before that moment), not “until”.

mistakes.text: By the time they {copied|started copying} her, she had {already |}found {own|an own} {look|style}.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'started copying' (začali kopírovať), add 'už' (already) and say 'štýl/styl' (style); all accepted.
